Kadrū
------------------------------------------
A daughter of the प्रजापति दक्ष, she was one of the thirteen wives of the sage कश्यप and the मोथेर् of serpents. विनता (the मोथेर् of गरुड) was her co-wife.
Once there was a dispute between them regarding the colour of the heavenly horse उच्चैश्रवस्. कद्रू won it by a wily manoeuvre and as a result विनता became her slave-maid as agreed earlier. However विनता was rescued by her valiant son गरुड.
The famous serpents शेष, वासुकि, Kārkoṭaka and Dhanañjaya were her sons. जरत्कारु was her daughter, later on married to the sage जरत्कारु, who was instrumental in stopping the सर्पयाग (sacrifice of snakes) of जनमेजय, the son of परीक्षित्.
See also VINATĀ.

Kādividyā
(‘[esoteric] science or मन्त्र beginning with “ka” ’)
------------------------------------------
It is the same as ‘Kādimata’.
See TANTRAS for details.
